newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh PM promises more reforms for growth.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh PM promises more reforms for growth.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said on Saturday her government would press ahead with reform measures to increase trade and investment.

"Our government is relentlessly working to implement a liberal trade policy and reform programmes," Hasina told nearly 300 foreign and local entrepreneurs while opening the "Dhaka International Trade fair '97".
Hasina said her government laid great importance on the promotion of trade and commerce. "Without it the progress and prosperity of the country will not be possible," she said.
Hasina, who assumed power following an election victory last June, said the government had enacted laws to allow foreigners to establish exclusive industrial zones.
The government has also wthdrawn the mandatory provision for disclosure of the source of income at the time of setting up an industrial unit, she said.
"Because of our policy capital investment is rising and exports growing," she said.
Almost half of Bangladesh's 112 million people live below the poverty line and about 68 percent of the population are illiterate.
